source.name: Berean Standard Bible
source.note: Headings only, for the 66 canonical books. None of the BSB's verse text is used here or shipped anywhere in the app.

deuterocanon.note: The BSB has no deuterocanon and no public-domain edition carries both those books and section headings, so these titles are written for this dataset. Anchors for the eleven books a Catholic edition divides follow those divisions, checked verse by verse against the ASV Byzantine Text; for 1ES, 2ES, 3MA, 4MA and PSS both the anchors and the titles are ours. English only: ASV BT is the one edition that carries these books and reads a heading set.
